scope: Read-only comparison of craft retail selection information and Google AdSense/Search primary policies. No competitor content/assets copied into the site, no application, login, checkout, analytics, paid service, domain migration or message to third parties.

method.web: Official documentation and live retailer page bodies read through web tooling. Links/controls were observed; competitor filter combinations and sales performance were not tested.
method.browser: Fresh headless Chrome with public pages only where web tooling had cache/access errors, plus actual host-root and existing project-route status checks.
method.internalEvidence: artifacts/competitive-audit-v11-browser.json; excluded from Git/public/source delivery because it contains external page body research material.
method.popularityLimit: No traffic, conversion, revenue or independent popularity ranking was established. Retailer Best selling/Popular Items/review displays are retailer representations, not evidence of this site's performance or a third-party ranking.
method.implementationLimit: Recommendations and original selection-note proposal are not proof of implementation. See spec011 and final verification/deployment reports for adopted changes.

hostingSuitability.assessment: GitHub Pages restricts free hosting for online businesses and sites primarily facilitating commercial transactions. PSL-based AdSense site eligibility does not override hosting terms. No on-site checkout is not automatic permission for an affiliate-focused operation; contract suitability or an alternative permitted host remains unresolved.

conclusion: Improve decision-useful original information and product diversity, not content volume for its own sake. The reviewed live site has working project routes but a404 host root; site acceptance, truthful account requirements, hosting-contract suitability and future ad data/consent/security settings remain separate from content improvements. No application or approval was performed.
